title: Review, install, and maintain your skills
intro: Review recommendations in fewer steps and keep control of changes to your library.

items.title: Review instructions, then install
items.description: Open a recommendation, read its instructions, and confirm its agent and destination. Save suggestions for later without installing them.
items.label: Review recommendations

items.title: Edit drafts and supporting files
items.description: Compare revisions, save drafts and templates, and review copies for other agents before installation.
items.label: Open your library

items.title: Maintain and recover your library
items.description: Use Maintain library in Add skills to review upstream updates, organize skills, and export or restore selected backups.
items.label: Open your library

items.title: Control the history you share
items.description: Check sampling coverage, filter and edit excerpts, exclude locations, or run a deeper scan before asking for recommendations.
items.label: Review history
